headline: ARC-3 gold cutoff rises as two teams fall outside

sections.text: The ARC-3 gold line rose 0.76 in the past day to 38.98, with 19th the last gold place. Nhan Duc Nguyen is 20th at 38.84, 0.14 short.
Advaith Vecham is now 21st at 38.22, also outside the gold places. Both teams held the same score as their ranks shifted.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
